title: Retro games component diagram
description: The games folder groups eight independent games. Five are browser games, each its own npm project with its own Cloudflare Worker: four have an engine, a page and a replay-checked high-score table, and Gambit is a Godot client whose Worker handles sign-in, games and history. LodeStar is a desktop game, a Rust workspace presented by Godot, with no server. MEG is a browser game served by a Worker behind the sign-in, with its high scores kept on each device, Hedgerow is a single-player Godot client whose Worker only serves it behind the sign-in, and Swarmhold is another. They share no code at build time, and three carry identical copies of the online module.

components.name: Retro games
components.responsibility: The eight games, side by side.

components.name: Rally
components.responsibility: Table tennis against the computer, or a friend online on their own device.

components.name: Hivestorm
components.responsibility: An arcade shooter for one player, or two online taking turns.

components.name: Shatterbelt
components.responsibility: A rock-breaking shooter for one pilot, or up to nine online, co-op or versus.

components.name: Samosa
components.responsibility: A remake of a 1983 ZX Spectrum strategy game, played screen by screen.

components.name: Gambit
components.responsibility: 3D chess in Godot: friends invited by email and played at their own pace with chat, or Stockfish at eight strengths; every game kept and replayable.

components.name: Hedgerow
components.responsibility: Single-player, turn-based WWII hex tactics in Godot against a computer opponent; everything runs in the browser.

components.name: Neon Snake
components.responsibility: Snake made new in Godot: a glowing snake that glides, combos and bonus stars, on a board that fits any window.

components.name: Swarmhold
components.responsibility: An original single-player rescue game in Godot: lead the last person out of a walled desert city overrun by giant ants; everything runs in the browser.

components.name: LodeStar
components.responsibility: A desktop space trading and combat game: deterministic rules in the Rust lodestar-core crate, presented in Godot 4.

components.name: MEG
components.responsibility: An original cartoon shark game: the player is the last megalodon, hiding in a warm current from the Directorate.

components.name: Games hub
components.responsibility: The games hub at icelander.net/games (the recreations repository's Worker): sign-in, /me, the multiplayer lobby and one WebSocket relay per online match.
